episodes.title: April 10th
episodes.summary: Shido Itsuka is an ordinary high school student living with his little sister in Tengu City, a city that is often disrupted by "spatial quakes". During a spatial quake at the beginning of the school year, he meets a beautiful and mysterious "Spirit".

episodes.title: Close Re-Encounter
episodes.summary: Shido practices making women fall in love with him and has another encounter with the Spirit "Princess".

episodes.title: Sword That Splits the Sky
episodes.summary: With the support of Ratatoskr, Shido goes on a date with Tohka as Origami watches from afar.

episodes.title: Unhappy Rain
episodes.summary: Shido encounters the mysterious "Hermit" one rainy day, and Tohka and Origami fight over Shido at school.

episodes.title: The Freezing Ground
episodes.summary: Shido goes to Origami`s apartment to look for Hermit`s puppet, Yoshinon, who was lost during the last fight, and Tohka talks with Reine about her feelings for Shido.

episodes.title: Hot Springs of Love
episodes.summary: Shido and the Spirits decide to visit Tengu City Hot Springs, but they run into some trouble on the way.

episodes.title: The Visitors
episodes.summary: A young AST joins Origami and the others in the fight against the Spirits. Meanwhile, another transfer student appears at Shido`s school.

episodes.title: Triple Frenzy
episodes.summary: Shido takes Tohka, Kurumi, and Origami out on dates on the same day. Will he be found out?

episodes.title: Raging Nightmare
episodes.summary: Shido and the others face off against "Nightmare", and they receive some unexpected help.

episodes.title: Spirit of Fire
episodes.summary: Shido learns the truth about his and Kotori`s powers, and Origami reveals more details about her past.

episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.summary: To get ready for his date with Kotori, Shido goes swimsuit shopping with Tohka and Yoshino. Meanwhile, Origami finds out more about Ifrit.

episodes.title: Things You Can't Give Up
episodes.summary: Shido and Kotori enjoy their date at the amusement park until they are interrupted by Origami.

episodes.title: Daily Life
episodes.summary: Shido and the Spirits are back, but Tohka`s powers are unstable as she and Origami continue to compete for Shido`s attention.

episodes.title: Hurricane Children
episodes.summary: Shido`s class goes on a trip to DEM-affiliated Arubi Island, where he and Tohka get separated from the class and encounter twin Spirits.

episodes.title: Two Requests
episodes.summary: The tables are turned as Kaguya and Yuzuru try to make Shido fall in love with them.

episodes.title: Manifestation
episodes.summary: In the air, the Fraxinus is under attack while Kotori is away, and Shido and Tohka are being attacked on the ground while Kaguya and Yuzuru fight their last duel.

episodes.title: Diva
episodes.summary: Shido meets Miku Izayoi, an idol also known as the Spirit, Diva, while getting ready for the joint cultural festival with other schools in Tengu City.

episodes.title: Girls' Music
episodes.summary: The Tenou Festival begins, and Shido has to cross-dress to participate in the activities as Shiori to satisfy Miku.

episodes.title: Gabriel
episodes.summary: When the results of the first day of the Tenou Festival are announced, Miku decides she doesn`t want to play by the rules anymore.

episodes.title: The Promise to Keep
episodes.summary: With Kurumi`s help, Shido tries to convince Miku to join him in rescuing Tohka, and Miku has second thoughts about her stance on Shido.

episodes.title: The Truth About Miku
episodes.summary: Shido learns more about Miku`s past, and they go to rescue Tohka together as Mana, Origami, and the others fight the Wizards.

episodes.title: Inversion
episodes.summary: Shido has to find a way to deal Tohka`s inverted form as the battle outside continues. Will he be able to restore order to the city?

episodes.title: The Seventh Spirit
episodes.summary: Shido meets a pretty trickster that loves to get compliments. He also runs amok at the school doing one naughty thing after another. Or does he?

episodes.title: Can You Find Me?
episodes.summary: While the witch impersonates one of his friends, Shido is forced into a game where he must identify Natsumi before it's too late and they all disappear.

episodes.title: You're Natsumi
episodes.summary: Shido is losing his head and losing friends faster with each passing day of Natsumi's game. But when it's all over, he may have a little problem on his hands.

episodes.title: Transformation
episodes.summary: Natsumi uses her powers to turn the girls into children. But their plan to convince Natsumi that her true form is cute turns out to be no child's play at all.

episodes.title: Despair Comes Crashing Down
episodes.summary: The Humpty Dumpty satellite has a great fall towards Tengu City. Will Natsumi realize her own self-worth before the city is reduced to rubble?

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.summary: Origami makes an unexpected decision that shakes things up. While Shido runs off to investigate, a spatial quake alarm lands the others in a special kind of trouble.

episodes.title: The Power Given
episodes.summary: As Fraxinus defends against a fierce opponent, Origami stops at nothing to fulfill her wish and makes the ultimate sacrifice. Will she regret the cost to gain what she wanted?

episodes.title: Demon King of Descending Darkness
episodes.summary: Origami is on a mission to avenge her parents, but when she finally discovers the truth, it turns out to be much harsher than she bargained for.

episodes.title: Tengu City, Five Years Ago
episodes.summary: On a mission to avert disaster, Shido attempts to rewrite history. Can he stop Origami's crazed rampage or are her parents doomed to die?

episodes.title: Another World, Another Girl
episodes.summary: Shido wakes up and finds that the world around him is different. His attempt to thwart disaster may have succeeded, but for how long will it last?

episodes.title: Angel of the Starry Night
episodes.summary: Shido takes Origami on a date but she's not acting like herself. After all hell breaks loose, the fate of the world depends on whether he can reach out to her heart or not.

episodes.title: Make Shido Itsuka Swoon
episodes.summary: All the sealed Spirit power is making Shido go wild, but the only cure is to kiss him again. Can all the girls entice Shido to fall for them before it's too late?

episodes.title: Don't Panic. This is a Spirit Trap
episodes.summary: Shido encounters a girl named Nia collapsed on the side of the road, but learns there's more to this manga artist than meets the eye.

episodes.title: So Be It! 2D It is!
episodes.summary: Shido tries to woo Nia whose heart is firmly set on 2D. In order to get Nia to read their manga, the crew challenges her to see who can sell more copies at Comico.

episodes.title: What's Yours Is Mine
episodes.summary: The girls struggle to sell more than Nia, but they have a few tricks up their sleeves. However, not even the Spirits are safe when Isaac Westcott comes to claim his prize.

episodes.title: Space Spirit
episodes.summary: When the Earth comes under attack by a Spirit from space, Shido attempts to charm her. The problem is, she's closed off her heart and just wants to be left alone.

episodes.title: Fairy Tale
episodes.summary: Trapped by Beelzebub in a world of fiction, the crew is desperate to escape. But without their powers to aid them, they're at the mercy of the story they're inside.

episodes.title: Locked Memories
episodes.summary: Mukuro resorts to drastic measures in order to monopolize Shido's heart. To gain his full love and affection, Mukuro locks away all memories of him.

episodes.title: Key and Sword
episodes.summary: In a competition for Shido's lips, Mukuro battles against Inverse Tohka. Before long, all goes wrong and Shido must stop Mukuro from destroying the planet.

episodes.title: Nightmare's Seduction
episodes.summary: Shocked by Kurumi's appearance at school, Shido and crew try to deduce her intentions. This time, Shido's date with a Spirit is a matter of life and death.

episodes.title: Girl Time
episodes.summary: After a lunchtime showdown, Kurumi and Shido plan to settle their competition on a special holiday. In the meantime, the Spirits help Shido prepare to face Kurumi in their own way.

episodes.title: Past Sins
episodes.summary: Shido takes charge during their Valentine's Day date and trusts his gut to capture Kurumi's heart. Before it ends, a look into Kurumi's past sheds light on how she became a Spirit.

episodes.title: Cycle of Salvation
episodes.summary: Driven by her resolve to erase the Spirit of Origin from existence, Kurumi is fighting a battle of her own. And at long last, the identity of Phantom is revealed.

episodes.title: Beginnings of War
episodes.summary: Kotori and the others gathered on the bridge of Fraxinus learn that Kurumi has traveled back in time over 204 times to try and save Shido. Shido also tries to search his memories to learn who Mio Takamiya is, but...

episodes.title: Final Respite
episodes.summary: The crew of Fraxinus sets about preparing for their battle against DEM with haste and high morale. The Spirits work hard to prepare snacks in order to encourage Shido and everyone else as the decisive battle draws closer by the hour...

episodes.title: The Spirit's Resurrection
episodes.summary: A full-scale confrontation between Shido and his friends Ratatoskr and DEM has begun. Kurumi and her clone, AST led by Ryoko Kusabe, join them, and as the battle intensifies, Shido confronts a horde of pseudo-Spirits, Nibeelcole.

episodes.title: The Spirit of Origin
episodes.summary: A certain time, a certain place. Shinji Takamiya encounters a spatial earthquake, but finds a girl at the scene. She remembers almost nothing about herself. Shinji gives her the name Mio and she goes to live with him and his younger sister, Mana.

episodes.title: Mother Mio
episodes.summary: Shido is flooded with memories as the girl named Mio Takamiya stands before him. She was the person with whom Shido once shared his feelings when he was Shinji Takamiya. Meanwhile, Kotori and the others learn of Reine's true identity.

episodes.title: The Three Magi
episodes.summary: As Shido rushes to the Spirits' side, Westcott blocks his path. Meanwhile, Tohka and the others find themselves overwhelmed and powerless before Mio's manifested Angel, Ein Sof Ohr.

episodes.title: The World Tree Sheds Leaves
episodes.summary: Many spirits were exhausted by Mio's Ein Sof Ohr and collapsed. Kotori directs Fraxinus toward Mio and fires her spirit cannon, Gungnir, but...

episodes.title: The One Who Pulled the Trigger
episodes.summary: Shido is shocked when Mio tells him that all the Spirits are dead. Stunned and unable to move, Mio nearly wipes his memories as Shido, but there is still one Spirit who's survived.

episodes.title: A "Second" Date
episodes.summary: Shido returns to a time before the final battle with DEM began, when no one has died yet. In order to avoid repeating the same future, Shido asks Reine out on a date. After hearing the story from Shido, Kotori and the Spirits support their date.

episodes.title: A Battlefield That Shouldn't Be Possible
episodes.summary: As Shido's date with Reine is winding down, Reine comes to the realization that history has been rewritten. With DEM approaching, Kurumi arrives at their location to aid Shido.

episodes.title: A Fleeting Paradise
episodes.summary: Kurumi manages to survive Mio's assault and the other Spirits arrive to aid Shido. Realizing why he failed to seal Mio previously, Shido plans to kiss her again and this time make her choose him over Shinji.

episodes.title: And The One She Chooses Is
episodes.summary: While Shido and Mio face each other and convey their feelings, Westcott activates his terrifying ritual. Can Shido and the others stop his plot from achieving fruition?
